doctrines.note: Veterancy: Top Line. Guide is post-Chaos-patch (edit 2026-06-28). Example build per OP: Epic Leadership Doctrine (-16% leadership cost), Epic Combat Doctrine, Linebreaker Doctrine V, Unit Damage Doctrine V, Health & Piercing Defence Doctrine V / Mobility V. Playstyle: the unit was originally made to buff your team but has INSANE dmg since mastery. X-move in, press 3 (For Freedom!) to buff yourself before taking any hits, instantly press 2 (Claymore Strike) when in melee, let them hit once, press V (makes press 2 hit once again), into 1 (Highland Charge) or retreat if you can (preferred). After the combo, get out and wait for cooldown if possible — better than anything. Don't charge in with 1 first: it takes time to hit, the combo gets slower, and it doesn't stack the Claymore; without For Freedom! the unit is really bad, so let them fight 15s after pressing 3, then retreat, wait CD, go in again. Tips & Tricks: when pressing 2 (Claymore Strike), let them hit once, press V (makes press 2 hit once again) — train in custom game first.
